items.title: Aaron Jones: Back in Sunday's game
items.text:
Jones (knee) returned to Sunday's contest in New Orleans, Dane Mizutani of the St. Paul Pioneer Press reports.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Injures knee Sunday

items.title: Aaron Jones: Exits early in Week 5

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Done for day with concussion
items.text:

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Getting checked for possible concussion
items.text:
Hockenson is under evaluation for a possible concussion and is considered questionable to return to Sunday's game at New Orleans.
